text: 大肥鱼军械库（dsh-armory）是一款 DSH 网页插件面板，集中管理全局与项目 MCP、技能、WorkBuddy 专家和插件市场。它通过 DSH 的 mcpManager 服务及浏览器面板呈现连接状态、工具 Schema、导入和安装流程；工具裁缝汇总本机会话中的工具调用与上下文占用。还可浏览连接器、SkillHub 技能、专家与社区插件目录，并在会话中挂载专家人设。适合希望在一个界面整理 DSH 工具、技能和扩展的用户；安装命令为 dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-armory，市场目录可直接读取公开服务，远程 MCP 的授权由用户按需完成。

dsh-armory is a DSH web panel for global/project MCP servers, skills, experts, and plugin markets. Host RPCs support status, imports, tool usage reports, installs, OAuth, and session personas. Install: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-armory`; public catalogs need no account.
想在一个面板里管理 DSH 的全局 MCP 和项目 MCP。
我想查看 MCP 是否连接、有哪些工具以及工具参数。
能不能把其他客户端的 MCP 配置预览后导入 DSH？
想统计哪些 MCP 工具很少调用、每轮占多少上下文。
我想从市场搜索并安装技能或 MCP 连接器。
有没有办法在聊天过程中给当前会话挂上或换掉专家人设？
想浏览社区插件和 MCP 目录，并查看项目说明。
I want one panel to manage global and project MCP servers in DSH.
Can I see which tools are unused and how much context their schemas take?
I want to browse and install skills, connectors, and community plugins from DSH.
大肥鱼军械库的功能「MCP 管理与导入」：查看服务器连接状态、传输和工具 Schema，并启用、禁用、重连或编辑条目。全局配置写入 profile，项目配置保存在项目目录；也可预览并导入其他客户端配置。
大肥鱼军械库的功能「工具裁缝」：扫描本机会话工具事件，统计调用、错误与最近使用时间，并估算注册 Schema 和真实下发工具清单的上下文成本。面板从工具账本 RPC 读取报告。
大肥鱼军械库的功能「连接器市场」：读取连接器目录并预览安装配置；可检查本机依赖、处理缺少的授权信息，再将 MCP 加入全局或项目配置。
大肥鱼军械库的功能「技能管理」：浏览已安装技能、查看详情、安装或卸载，并维护自定义技能套件；卸载只接受受支持来源和技能根目录内的条目。
大肥鱼军械库的功能「专家人设」：从专家目录查看人设与捆绑技能，可为新会话写入预设，也能把人设挂到当前会话并随时切换或摘除。
大肥鱼军械库的功能「MCP OAuth 授权」：连接器安装前识别远程服务授权需求，可启动浏览器授权、轮询回调、手动提交令牌并刷新已保存的授权。
大肥鱼军械库的功能「社区目录」：搜索和分页浏览官方 MCP Registry 与 DSH 社区插件目录，查看条目详情或 README，再按界面流程加入配置或安装。
大肥鱼军械库的功能「项目 MCP 连接」：查看项目 MCP 和全局连接在项目中的可见情况，添加、更新或移除项目服务器，并对存活会话同步连接变化。
大肥鱼军械库使用 OAuth 时会在本机开启临时 loopback 回调监听，并把授权令牌保存在 ~/.dsh/armory-oauth/；连接器也可能需要用户提供自己的令牌。

dsh-armory README · dsh-armory · 军械库：中文 | [English](README.en.md)

> **你不需要记住 DSH 里装过什么。**
> 军械库把 MCP、技能、专家、插件和四个市场收进一块面板：316 个连接器、19 万+ 技能、429 位专家。装过什么、连没连上、哪些工具在吃 token，打开就能看见；会话里要用什么，也能直接叫出来。
dsh-armory README · dsh-armory · 军械库：
dsh-armory README · 装上一块面板：```sh
dsh-armory README · npm（推荐，免构建授权）：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-armory

dsh-armory README · 从 GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:2026heshao/dsh-armory
```

装完**完全退出 DSH 再启动**。左上角「全局面板」里会多一行「大肥鱼军械库」，点开就是；右下角悬浮按钮和左侧栏底部也能进。桌面端把 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile desktop`。

三个入口可以只留一个，也可以全开。面板右上角「入口」里切，不会出现三个都关掉、自己开不了的局面。

> 不要把 `dsh-armory` 手工插进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`、Agent preset 或额外的 `--patch` 文件。插件命令已经完成这件事，重复装配会明确报错。

dsh-armory README · MCP：连没连上，一眼看到：每个 MCP 一行：状态、传输方式、连接参数、工具数。展开能看到完整的输入 Schema，必填、可选、枚举、默认值都在。凭据默认打码，需要时点一下临时显示，再点一次收回。连不上时就地重连，不用重启宿主。

全局和项目分开管。全局写 profile，所有项目可用；项目写 `.dsh/mcp.json`，只对这个项目的会话可见。项目里还能屏蔽某个全局 MCP，别的项目不受影响。项目配置保存即对正在运行的会话生效，不用重开会话。

从别的客户端搬过来，也不用逐条抄。Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Windsurf、VS Code、Gemini CLI、Roo Code 等 11 种客户端的配置会被自动检出，预览后一键导入；同名冲突只跳过那一条。粘贴 `mcpServers` JSON 也行。

远端 MCP 要 OAuth 时，服务器返回 401 会直接弹出授权框；浏览器走完发现、注册、PKCE 和回调，令牌写回配置，由插件在到期前刷新。回调收不到时，可以粘贴回调地址或访问令牌。

dsh-armory README · 工具裁缝：谁在吃 token：每个 MCP 的工具描述都会跟着请求进上下文。零调用的工具不干活，但照样占位。

工具裁缝读本机会话日志，只看调用事件，不读聊天正文。它按 7 / 30 / 90 天统计每个工具的调用、错误率和最后使用时间，再算两笔账：注册表里这份 Schema 值多少 token，线上下发的清单又值多少。两个数对不上，就说明你改了配置没生效，或者线上和注册表不是同一份。

窗口内一次没调用的工具会进死工具清单，行内一键禁用，随时恢复。技能也有账本：注册了但一次没被调用，照样列出来；不想让它占上下文，可以在行内禁用，手动 `/引用` 不受影响。

dsh-armory README · 专家：叫一个进当前会话：WorkBuddy 专家中心有 429 位专家、15 个行业，其中 53 个是团队。看详情、看人设、看捆绑技能，点「召唤」就挂到当前会话。

聊到一半也能挂；换一个直接替换，点 chip 的 × 取消，只影响这一个会话。选择会随会话记住：切会话、重启 DSH、上下文压缩后 agent 重建，都会自动补回来。

上游有 185 位专家没有公开的人设文件。军械库会先读本机 WorkBuddy 缓存，再读公开分发；都没有，就用公开介绍生成一份兜底人设，正文第一段写明「这份人设不是原文」，并告诉你把原文放到哪个路径。团队专家会把每位成员的人设落到本机，再用 DSH 的 `subagent` 接上原来的协作流程。
section: 专家：叫一个进当前会话

text:
dsh-armory README · 会话里：技能、MCP、专家、本项目：输入框右侧的小图标打开召唤菜单。点技能插入 `/技能名`，点 MCP 点名 `mcp__服务__*`，点专家挂到当前会话；第四项「本项目」只列当前项目自己的技能和 MCP。最近用过的排在最前。

常一起用的技能可以打包成「套件」，点一次就按顺序插入多个 `/name`。不用每次都翻列表。
section: 会话里：技能、MCP、专家、本项目

text:
dsh-armory README · 市场：四个货架，装完找得回来：连接器、技能、专家、插件，四个市场都在面板里，不用另开网页。卡片上能看到发布方和最近更新，详情再按需查 GitHub，直接标出「近 30 天有提交 / 超过半年未更新 / 已归档」。

**连接器**：316 个 WorkBuddy 官方连接器。242 个可装，CLI 型或需要 token 注入的 74 个标明「仅展示」并写原因。装之前先检查本机依赖；装完按真实连接态显示「已连接 / 需授权 / 未连接」，401 或 403 就地给「重新授权」。token 型连接器还会告诉你凭据去哪申请，只给公开 https 链接，不猜地址、不代填。
section: 市场：四个货架，装完找得回来

text:
dsh-armory README · 市场：四个货架，装完找得回来：**技能**：SkillHub 公开 API，19 万+ 技能。搜索、排序、一键安装，逐文件 sha256 校验，装进 `~/.agents/skills/` 立刻生效。装完卡片上标「装于 3 小时前」，7 天内高亮；筛选条有「最近安装」时间线；看板名和市场名不一致时，会标「来自市场 原名」。不用再翻目录猜哪个是刚装的。看板顶部能在「全局」和「各工作区」之间切，切到某个项目时只显示该项目 `.agents/skills` 与 `.dsh/skills` 里的技能。不要的技能可以在详情里直接卸载，二次确认后永久删除。

**专家**：429 位，分类加搜索，卡片直接召唤。

**插件**：聚合两个 DSH 社区清单，七千多条，每条标明可装性；点开卡片能直接看仓库 README，不用跳浏览器。安装走宿主 `pluginManager`，装完提示重启。
section: 市场：四个货架，装完找得回来

text: dsh-armory README · 市场：四个货架，装完找得回来：连接器页还能切到官方 MCP Registry 的社区来源，不依赖 WorkBuddy 账号。Windows 上从市场加入的 `npx` / `npm` 类 MCP 会被归一到本机 `node.exe`，不会再出现「连接已关闭」然后重连到永久失败。
section: 市场：四个货架，装完找得回来

text:
dsh-armory README · 装过什么，有账：`~/.dsh/armory/install-state.json` 记下每条连接器、技能、插件来自哪个市场，并把「军械库装的」和「手动配的」分开。市场页可以跨页筛出已安装项。

「装备清单」能把本机的 MCP、技能、专家、插件导出成一份 JSON。换机时粘贴或选文件导入，逐项比较「已安装 / 可更新 / 本机没有」。清单只含名称、类型、来源、版本和必要的身份字段，不写密钥、header、环境变量值，也不带技能正文和人设。
dsh-armory README · 不适合谁：如果你只是偶尔用 DSH 聊天，没装 MCP、技能或专家，这块面板确实用不上。它解决的是装得多了以后记不住、找不到、关不掉的问题。

dsh-armory README · 你可以放心的几件事：- 不会自动升级。有新版只在面板顶部提示，点了才动；固定 tag 安装的不会跨版本。
- 不把密钥送到浏览器。市场只带「需要哪些变量名」，值留在宿主配置里。
- 不动你别的配置。全局只改由本插件管理的 MCP 条目，其他插件、注释、`!!js` 表达式原样保留。
- 卸载插件不会删掉你已经配好的 MCP，项目的 `.dsh/mcp.json` 也留在原处。
- 第三方市场内容标明来源；外链只放行 https，http 仅限本机回环。

dsh-armory README · 升级与兼容：升级：npm 安装的可以在面板提示条上点「升级」，或执行 `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-armory`。升级后**完全退出 DSH 再启动**，宿主侧模块只在进程启动时加载一次。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-armory`，已有的 MCP 条目不会被删除。

兼容：DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` 及以上，已验证到 `0.2.1-rc.2`（DSH 44.7.0）。Windows 实测；Linux 和 macOS 走同一套 DSH Web 契约。

界面语言跟随 DSH。中文环境显示中文，其他语言回落英文。想强制英文，在 DevTools 里设 `localStorage['dsh-armory.locale'] = 'en-US'` 再刷新。

dsh-armory README · 常见问题：**升级后没变化？**
先确认装上的版本：看升级后第一次打开面板的「vX.Y.Z 的更新」卡片标题，或 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-armory/package.json` 的 `version`。再完全退出 DSH 重启。只刷新面板不够。

**面板显示「已禁用」，模型却报 `unknown tool`？**
这个 MCP 被禁用了，所以没有注册工具。在面板里点「启用」就行。

**Windows 上加入的 MCP 连不上？**
2.4.5 起会把裸 `npx` / `npm` 归一成本机绝对路径。如果你是从别的机器导入了配置，命令里的路径可能不属于这台机器，重新「加入 MCP」即可。

**专家详情写着「这份人设不是原文」？**
上游没有公开的人设文件，这是兜底版本，不影响召唤。把原文放到 `~/.dsh/wb-market/experts/overrides/<包名>.md`，下次打开就换成原文。

**卸载会丢配置吗？**
不会。已有的 MCP 条目和项目 `.dsh/mcp.json` 都保留。

> **You should not have to remember what you installed in DSH.**
> Armory puts MCP servers, skills, experts, plugins and four markets on one board: 316 connectors, 190,000+ skills, 429 experts. What is installed, what is connected, and which tools are eating context are all in front of you. You can also call any of it from the session.
dsh-armory README · dsh-armory · Armory：
dsh-armory README · Install the board：```sh
dsh-armory README · npm (recommended: no build approval, ready to use)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-armory
section: npm (recommended: no build approval, ready to use)

text:
dsh-armory README · GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:2026heshao/dsh-armory
```

**Quit DSH completely and start it again.** Then open "Big Fish Armory" from the global panel list at the top of the sidebar. The floating button at the bottom right and the sidebar bottom entry open the same board. On desktop, swap `--profile web` for `--profile desktop`.

You can keep one entry, two, or all three. Switch them under "Entries" in the top right of the board. It will not let you close all three and lock yourself out.

dsh-armory README · GitHub：> Do not add `dsh-armory` to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, an agent preset or an extra `--patch` file by hand. The plugin command already does that, and duplicating it fails loudly on purpose.

dsh-armory README · MCP: see whether it is connected：Each server gets a row: status, transport, connection settings, tool count. Open it for the full input schema, including required fields, enums and defaults. Credentials are masked. Click the eye to read the effective runtime value for a moment, and click again to hide it. If a server drops, reconnect in place without restarting the host.
section: MCP: see whether it is connected

text: dsh-armory README · MCP: see whether it is connected：Global and project scopes are separate. Global writes to the profile and is available in every project. A project writes to `.dsh/mcp.json` and is visible only to sessions in that project. Inside a project you can hide a global server without touching other projects. Saving a project config applies to live sessions immediately; no restart.
section: MCP: see whether it is connected

text: dsh-armory README · MCP: see whether it is connected：Moving from another client does not mean copying configs by hand. Armory detects 11 clients, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Gemini CLI and Roo Code, shows a preview, and imports the ones you pick. A name collision skips that one entry instead of failing the batch. You can also paste an `mcpServers` JSON block.
section: MCP: see whether it is connected

text: dsh-armory README · MCP: see whether it is connected：When a remote MCP needs OAuth, a 401 opens the authorization dialog. The browser completes discovery, registration, PKCE and the callback. The token is written back to the config, and the plugin refreshes it before expiry. If the callback cannot be received, you can paste the callback URL or an access token.
section: MCP: see whether it is connected

text:
dsh-armory README · Tool Tailor: who is eating context：Every MCP tool description travels with the request. A tool nobody calls still takes up space.

Tool Tailor reads local session logs. It looks at call events only, not message content. For the last 7, 30 or 90 days it counts calls, errors and last use per tool, then compares two numbers: the token cost of the schema in the registry, and the token cost of the tool list actually sent in each request. When they differ, your config did not take effect, or the live list is not the registry list.
section: Tool Tailor: who is eating context

text: dsh-armory README · Tool Tailor: who is eating context：Tools with zero calls in the window go on a dead-tool list. One click disables the server, and one click brings it back. Skills get the same ledger: a registered skill that was never called is listed, and you can disable it from the row. That writes the official `disable-model-invocation` key to `SKILL.md`; manual `/` invocation still works.
section: Tool Tailor: who is eating context

text:
dsh-armory README · Experts: summon one into the session：WorkBuddy's expert directory has 429 experts across 15 industries, including 53 teams. Read the persona, see the bundled skills, and hit Summon to attach one to the current session.

You can attach one halfway through a conversation. Replace it by summoning another; remove it with the × on the chip. It only affects that session. The choice is remembered across session switches, restarts and context compaction.
section: Experts: summon one into the session

text: dsh-armory README · Experts: summon one into the session：About 185 of the 429 experts have no public persona file. Armory reads your local WorkBuddy cache first, then the public distribution. If neither exists, it writes a stand-in from the public description. The first paragraph says this is not the original and tells you where to put the original file. For team experts, each member's persona is written to disk and the lead is wired to DSH's `subagent` so the original teamwork rules still hold.
section: Experts: summon one into the session

text: dsh-armory README · In the session: skills, MCP, experts, this project：The small icon to the right of the composer opens the summon menu. Click a skill to insert `/skill-name`, click an MCP server to name its `mcp__server__*` tools, click an expert to attach it to the current session. The fourth row, This project, lists only the skills and MCP servers that belong to the current project. Recently used entries float to the top.

text: dsh-armory README · Markets: four shelves, and installs you can find later：**Connectors**: 316 official WorkBuddy connectors. 242 can be installed; 74 CLI or token-based ones are marked display-only with the reason. Armory checks local dependencies before install. After install, the card reports the real state: connected, needs authorization, or not connected. A 401 or 403 gives you a reauthorize action instead of a reconnect loop. Token-based connectors also tell you where to apply for credentials, with public https links only. text: dsh-armory README · Markets: four shelves, and installs you can find later：**Skills**: SkillHub's public API, 190,000+ skills. Search, sort, install in one click. Each file is checked against its sha256 and written to `~/.agents/skills/`, so it is live immediately. The card says "installed 3 hours ago" and stays highlighted for 7 days. The filter bar has a recent-installs timeline. If the board name differs from the market name, the card shows the original name. The top of the board switches between Global and each workspace; a workspace shows only the skills under its `.agents/skills` and `.dsh/skills`. Unneeded skills can be removed from the detail pane after a second confirmation; removal is permanent.

section: A record of what you installed

text: dsh-armory README · A record of what you installed：Loadout exports your MCP servers, skills, experts and plugins as a JSON file. Paste or import it on another machine and Armory compares each item as installed, update available, or missing. The file contains names, types, sources, versions and the identifiers needed to match them. It does not contain keys, headers, environment values, skill bodies or personas.
section: A record of what you installed

text: dsh-armory README · Who it is not for：If you only use DSH for occasional chat and have no MCP servers, skills or experts, you do not need this board. It solves the problem that shows up after you install a few things: you cannot remember what is there, find what you just added, or turn off what is costing you.

dsh-armory README · What it will not do：- It will not upgrade itself. A new release shows a banner; nothing happens until you click Upgrade. Tag-pinned installs do not jump versions.
- It will not send secrets to the browser. The market tells you which variable names are needed; values stay in the host config.
- It will not touch your other config. Global edits only change MCP entries owned by this plugin. Other bundles, comments and `!!js` expressions are left alone.
- Uninstalling the plugin does not delete your MCP entries or your project `.dsh/mcp.json`.
- Third-party market entries keep their source labels. Links must be https (http only for loopback).

dsh-armory README · Upgrade and compatibility：Upgrade from the banner in the panel, or run `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-armory`. **Quit DSH completely and start it again**; the host-side modules load once at process start. Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-armory`; existing MCP entries stay.

DSH `0.1.5-rc.1` or newer. Tested through `0.2.1-rc.2` (DSH 44.7.0) on Windows; Linux and macOS use the same DSH web contract.

dsh-armory README · Upgrade and compatibility：The UI follows DSH's language. Chinese shows Chinese; other locales fall back to English. To force English, set `localStorage['dsh-armory.locale'] = 'en-US'` in DevTools and reload.

dsh-armory README · FAQ：**Nothing changed after an upgrade.**
Check the installed version first: the title of the "What's new in vX.Y.Z" card on first open, or `version` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-armory/package.json`. Then quit DSH completely and start it again. Reloading the panel is not enough.

**The panel says a server is disabled, but the model reports `unknown tool`.**
That server is disabled, so it registers no tools. Enable it in the panel.

dsh-armory README · FAQ：**An MCP added on Windows will not connect.**
Since 2.4.5, bare `npx` and `npm` are rewritten to absolute local paths. A config imported from another machine may point at paths that do not exist here; add it through the market again.

**The expert detail says the persona is not the original.**
The upstream directory has no public persona for that expert. The stand-in still works for summoning. Put the original at `~/.dsh/wb-market/experts/overrides/<package>.md` and reopen the detail.

dsh-armory README · FAQ：**Will uninstalling delete my config?**
No. Existing MCP entries and project `.dsh/mcp.json` files stay.
